description: Cancel an unpaid request before payment starts. Pass expected_revision as an integer from the latest get_request. Only expected_revision is sent in the HTTP body; do not add sample_id or requisition fields. On revision_conflict, retry once with error.revision (error.next_action is cancel) and do not repeat the old revision. On invalid_input, fix error.invalid and error.missing, then retry once with error.revision. Paid orders require support.

expected_revision.description: Required integer. Current request revision, or error.revision from a cancel revision_conflict / invalid_input. Do not send a string.

name: cancel_request
title: Cancel request
